title: A constructible sheaf on the pro-etale site of a Noetherian scheme is lisse on the pieces of a finite partition
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian scheme X, a Noetherian ring Lambda and an ideal I, every constructible Lambda-sheaf on the pro-etale site of X becomes lisse on the pieces of a finite partition by locally closed subschemes (statement lines 5731-5739). The proof (proof lines 5741-5780) builds the associated graded sheaf of the ideal-adic filtration as a constructible sheaf of finite type over a Noetherian graded ring, makes it locally constant by the partition theorem, and propagates local constancy back to the sheaf by induction along the short exact sequences. H3: an original construction reducing a pro-etale statement to a graded etale one, written out in full.
